wood_wide_web.named_path: common mycorrhizal network (CMN) as the transport

alternatives.name: diffusion through soil water
alternatives.notes: Karst et al.: dye/isotope movement has equally plausible soil-water path. Field designs rarely include a diffusion-only control at plot scale.
alternatives.source: Nat Ecol Evol 2023 10.1038/s41559-023-01986-1; The Conversation 13 Feb 2023

alternatives.name: direct root–root contact
alternatives.notes: Root grafts and contact are documented. Severing hyphae in pots does not exclude contact in a forest.

alternatives.name: other soil microbes (non-CMN)
alternatives.notes: Bacteria and saprotrophs move carbon. 'Fungal network' is not isolated by a mesh that other microbes cross.

alternatives.name: eavesdropping / byproduct volatiles (not a message)
alternatives.notes: Oxford 2025 model: plants do not 'warn'; neighbours intercept a byproduct. Information-flow sign inverted. Not excluded by isotope movement.
alternatives.source: The Average Scientist 20 Aug 2025 citing 2025 Oxford model

alternatives.name: CMN as occasional conduit (not forest-scale web)
alternatives.notes: The modest remaining claim. Still unquantified at stand scale. Not an ordinary confounder; the residual hypothesis.
alternatives.source: Karst: fungi likely connect trees in many forests; extent unknown

wood_wide_web.verdict: IOA Type I HOLDS for 'wood-wide web resource / warning transfer': 4 ordinary alternative path(s) remain unexcluded in the field. Named path 'common mycorrhizal network (CMN) as the transport' is therefore not entitled to be the operator.
wood_wide_web.runnable_discriminator: Pre-register a stand-scale design: (i) hyphal-exclusion meshes that block CMN but permit soil-water and microbes; (ii) root-isolation trenches; (iii) volatile-only chambers; (iv) intact CMN. Primary outcome = 13C / 15N movement and seedling survival, frozen before collection. Run in ≥2 biomes. Negative control: randomized mesh assignment with no live hyphae (killed-fungus plots).
wood_wide_web.null_of_discriminator: Isotope movement and survival differences vanish in the hyphal-exclusion condition once soil-water and root-contact are matched. Then CMN is not the operator. IOA Type I closes as 'named path lost'.
wood_wide_web.success_of_discriminator: A residual in the intact-CMN plots survives all three ordinary exclusions, same sign, ≥2 biomes, fails the killed-fungus control. Then IOA was the right question and a CMN operator may exist. Still not 'trees talk'. Still not a mother-tree decision.
wood_wide_web.ethics: existing research forests; no new clearcutting; meshes/trenches at seedling-plot scale

k2_18b.named_path: Earth-DMS-from-marine-life imported as identity onto a spectral wiggle

alternatives.name: instrumental offset / retrieval artefact
alternatives.notes: Seager 2025: signal sensitive to instrumental offset; ~3σ not 5σ. Taylor 2025: consistent with flat line.

alternatives.name: other sulfur gases sharing spectral features
alternatives.notes: Seager: attribution may be incorrect; other sulfur gases share features.

alternatives.name: abiotic DMS chemistry in H2-rich atmosphere
alternatives.notes: Even a real DMS detection would not cash the operator 'DMS ⇒ life'. Abiotic paths unexcluded on a Hycean world.

alternatives.name: model-comparison artefact (11-species vs 10-species reference)
alternatives.notes: Tentative detection is a preference of a 5-biosignature reference model vs 4. Not a spectral line detection.

k2_18b.verdict: IOA Type I HOLDS for 'K2-18b DMS/DMDS named as biosignature': 4 ordinary alternative path(s) remain unexcluded in the field. Named path 'Earth-DMS-from-marine-life imported as identity onto a spectral wiggle' is therefore not entitled to be the operator.
k2_18b.runnable_discriminator: Independent reduction with pre-registered: (1) robustness to offset treatment, (2) nested models that do not privilege biosignature gases, (3) abiotic sulfur chemistry grid, (4) 5σ line criterion. NASA-led arXiv:2507.12622 is the live test (~2.7σ).
k2_18b.null_of_discriminator: Feature consistent with flat line or with abiotic sulfur. Identity-import fails. IOA Type II closes as 'name was doing the work'.
k2_18b.success_of_discriminator: 5σ feature, abiotic grid excluded, offset-robust. Still NOT life — only a molecule. Life remains a further operator.
k2_18b.ethics: telescope time already allocated; no new claim of contact

k2_18b_after_census.note: Guard routes to NCR/IM because named cause (DMS) is insufficient. Engine keeps Type II IOA as penalized remainder. Not primary.
